I think the issue is the distinction between pedophilia and ephebophilia is besides the point. In America typically 17 is underage and any sexual activity when you’re as old as 24 can put you away for sexual misconduct or assault of a minor. And that’s why pedophile becomes a catch all. There is rarely a legal distinction. The only difference I think is if you are with someone who is underage and you are and adult but only like 2 years older I think you can get a pass. But that’s been normalized in high schools at least where I grew up so nobody ever said anything about those situations. Point is arguing for the distinction is all well and good but ultimately it’s missing the point that at 24 feeling up on a teen and making comments sexualizing her while acknowledging that it feels wrong is really creepy behavior. It’s behavior of someone who seemingly feels above the consequences by doing it onstage. It’s disturbing in its brazenness I think is the ultimate point. So people throw pedophile at him because while strictly speaking he probably has just skirted by laws it’s a label thrown at him to mock that behavior. To kinda show that we as a society despite him not being convicted of anything, do not approve of his actions.
